reasons.reader_question: The roar stops and the queen asks who will go up. The question about Vellan's fate is sharp and specific.
reasons.change: Devan's hand is diagnosed as lost, the bond turns from drag to support, the queen confesses, and Vellan falls silent.
reasons.romance_movement: The new reason is that staying becomes the act of love. The cost of the bond becomes rest, a fresh turn.
reasons.shown_chemistry: His first words are about her cold legs. His hand goes into her fur with 'Stubborn. Good.' She syncs to his hitch. All responsive.
reasons.character_logic: Neela's choice is smart. But Muthu leaves the archer line all night during the tower assault with no reason given.
reasons.stakes_and_cost: Her dead hind legs make 'go up' nearly impossible, so the choice to stay costs less than it should.
reasons.prose: Clean and concrete. Too many 'It was not X. It was Y' pairs, aphorisms ('not hard to see... hard to do'), and the 'light as a held breath' cliché.
reasons.continuity: The queen says Usha's welt is the first time a knife 'told me she was hurt', but she felt Usha's welt sting at ch24 (F938, F1043).

fixes: At "this is the first time one of them has told me she was hurt" there is a continuity conflict: the queen already felt Usha's welt at the ch24 naming (F938, F1043). Rewrite it as "the first time one of them has been hurt in a fight where I could not see her". Keep "I know it the way I know my own pulse" only as an inference from the welt, not as a sense of life, since the share carries wounds only (F265).

At "She could have been up the stones in three bounds, if her legs would carry her" technique 18 is undercut: dead legs remove the choice. Have the cold ease to the knees just before Devan says 'Go up', so she can feel she could rise. Then she chooses to stay with the bear roaring, and the cost is real.

At "She was bleeding there, a little, in the thick fur" the text conflicts with F627 (a partner's welt weeps but does not open). Change it to a hot, weeping welt. Separately, add one line before the night watch where Muthu hands the archers to a named man, or have him go and return, so his all-night absence from the line makes sense.
reader_question: Did Vellan survive holding the cut alone, and who will climb up to find out?
new_facts_assessment: Drawing the shaft out the back fits F942 and is needed for the surgery. Unlisted additions need logging: Thankam is the drying-shed woman with the paring knife, Muthu's coat over Neela, and the throat healing point learned at the Resin House. All are consistent. The line 'Her mother's people could not have taught her' is unclear and should be cut or clarified.
